mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a money saver because it is cheaper to make mistakes on paper than in practice. 5."
A budget is a money saver because it is cheaper to make mistakes on paper than in practice. 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to measure rate of technical change in production (chamber, 1988)."
Productivity is used to measure rate of technical change in production (chamber, 1988).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the whole farm system so all expenses and receipts likely to be incurred are included."
Complete budgets are concerned with the whole farm system so all expenses and receipts likely to be incurred are included.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those assets which are used up within the production process of the business."
Intermediate or working assets are those assets which are used up within the production process of the business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical ratio of product output to the factor input, the greater the ratio, the greater the magnitude of technical efficiency."
Technical efficiency in production is the physical ratio of product output to the factor input, the greater the ratio, the greater the magnitude of technical efficiency.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability to survive unexpected low income and unforeseen costs and still stay in business."
Risk - bearing ability is the ability to survive unexpected low income and unforeseen costs and still stay in business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a previously agreed proportion of the total crop, often a half."
The share is a previously agreed proportion of the total crop, often a half.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation, where there are both technical and allocative efficiencies."
Economic efficiency is a situation, where there are both technical and allocative efficiencies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic but complex management function combining financial, physical and technical aspects for selecting and developing the best of the alternative ways of achieving stated objectives."
Planning is a basic but complex management function combining financial, physical and technical aspects for selecting and developing the best of the alternative ways of achieving stated objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a production subsystem in an economy and normally identified as a business venture."
The farm is a production subsystem in an economy and normally identified as a business venture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with choosing optimal sets of inputs."
Allocative efficiency is concerned with choosing optimal sets of inputs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the location of land, the quality of the soil and the advantages and disadvantages of the climatic factors associated with the land ii."
The farm manager is concerned with the location of land, the quality of the soil and the advantages and disadvantages of the climatic factors associated with the land ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those assets which cannot be easily converted into cash to meet current obligations."
Fixed or long-term assets are those assets which cannot be easily converted into cash to meet current obligations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the original and indestructible property of the earth."
Land is defined as the original and indestructible property of the earth.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the work done by human beings and not the persons themselves, when a farmer hires a labour he is buying only so many hours of work and not the man himself."
The resources called labour is the work done by human beings and not the persons themselves, when a farmer hires a labour he is buying only so many hours of work and not the man himself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the average product of all input factors."
Total factor productity (TFP) is defined as the average product of all input factors.
